courseTitle: NativeScript + Angular: Build Native iOS, Android & Web Apps

cues.en: So in this module, we had a look at how you send HTP requests from inside your Nayda script app and
turns out you do it in exactly the same way.
You do it in a normal Angella for app because you use the angular web client, the to htp client just
wrapped bidi native script HDB client module.
In the end, what you need to import in your app module to use the ANGULAR declined in your application.
And with that we use that here in the service.
You all just saw how to extract data by tapping into it as one example pattern.
And of course, you also saw how you could implement an activity indicator.
So a loading spinner essentially here in our tapu and how you can make sure that you still navigate
correctly after the data is loaded.
Last but not least, we had a look at how we use that data on the front end and here on the back.
And we can, of course, see all the data we stored and that is awesome.
The next step is that we protected through authentication so that every user has its own challenge.
And, well, we can't just use our app in an unauthenticated way.
